description: Primary routing fixtures and explicitly required handoffs for the security-hunt Skill.

cases.prompt: A repository configuration file is accepted as passive text, but a later privileged build automatically executes a hook declared in it.
cases.reason: The same file changes from data to executable control content across processing stages.

cases.prompt: An API binder accepts a client-selected type marker and restores an unintended runtime class whose getter is invoked downstream.
cases.reason: Deserialization changes the runtime object graph and dispatch target.

cases.prompt: Sanitized rich text is serialized and inserted again, producing a different executable DOM after browser repair.
cases.reason: The sanitizer and final browser derive different parse trees from the same content.

cases.prompt: A nested filter writes constructor.prototype.isAdmin, and newly created request objects later inherit the authorization flag.
cases.reason: A generic object write changes inherited properties consumed by another module.

cases.prompt: A user-controlled approval reason is stored literally but ANSI cursor controls hide the real request ID in an operator terminal.
cases.reason: Stored text is reinterpreted as a stateful terminal control language.

cases.prompt: A download filename containing encoded line breaks is persisted and later reparsed as two MIME headers by a mail service.
cases.reason: Protocol data becomes control fields when a downstream receiver reparses it.

cases.prompt: A JSON search filter accepts an injected NoSQL operator and changes query semantics.
cases.reason: Data is reinterpreted as control syntax by a server-side query interpreter.

cases.prompt: An account allowlist compares raw characters, but storage applies NFKC and resolves the identifier to a protected account name.
cases.reason: Validation and lookup use different character-equivalence rules.

cases.prompt: An uploaded archive writes a file outside the extraction directory after decoding and normalization.
cases.reason: Canonicalization changes the final filesystem target.

cases.prompt: The gateway validates the first role parameter while the application uses the second duplicate value.
cases.reason: Two parsers select different values from the same request.

cases.prompt: A reverse proxy accepts one HTTP request, but the reused backend connection parses the bytes as two requests and applies the second to the next user.
cases.reason: HTTP hops disagree about message boundaries and ownership of the next request.

cases.prompt: A webhook URL passes the allowlist but redirects and resolves to an internal address at connection time.
cases.reason: Validation and the final network address diverge.

cases.prompt: An untrusted X-Forwarded-Host value changes the absolute password-reset link generated behind a trusted reverse proxy.
cases.reason: The proxy and application disagree about the canonical external host.

cases.prompt: An OAuth callback can bind the attacker's provider identity to the victim's existing session.
cases.reason: The callback, state, session, and target account are misbound.

cases.prompt: A one-time organization invitation token can be consumed by a different logged-in account through the registration endpoint.
cases.reason: A valid token is not bound to the intended subject, purpose, and entry point.

cases.prompt: Completing MFA in browser session A also elevates browser session B for a sensitive action.
cases.reason: Authentication assurance is not bound to the session that completed the factor.

cases.prompt: A user-controlled sibling subdomain can set a parent-domain session cookie that the high-trust application accepts.
cases.reason: A low-trust DNS boundary inherits browser identity capabilities of the parent domain.

cases.prompt: Changing the orderId in an authenticated API request returns another user's order.
cases.reason: The primary boundary is authorization for a different object owner.

cases.prompt: A normal member can call an undocumented tenant-admin endpoint directly.
cases.reason: The caller reaches a function outside the effective role capability.

cases.prompt: Changing X-Organization-ID makes a report export read data from another workspace.
cases.reason: Client-controlled tenant context crosses a storage and export boundary.

cases.prompt: A postMessage listener checks only a suffix of event.origin and lets a sibling site invoke an account action in the parent window.
cases.reason: An unintended message source receives a capability on a cross-origin channel.

cases.prompt: A cross-site HTML form can submit the cookie-authenticated email-change request.
cases.reason: Ambient browser credentials are treated as proof of user intent.

cases.prompt: A response varies by an authentication header that is omitted from the CDN cache key and is served to another user.
cases.reason: A security-relevant response variant is omitted from shared cache identity.

cases.prompt: A WebSocket is authenticated once, but subscription messages can request another tenant's object IDs.
cases.reason: Per-operation and per-object authorization is missing on a long-lived channel.

cases.prompt: A malicious DNS response stores an unrelated record that is later returned to an independent resolver client.
cases.reason: Remote input contaminates shared protocol state consumed by a later request.

cases.prompt: Calling the finalize endpoint directly skips approval but still moves the order to completed.
cases.reason: A mandatory business-state precondition is not enforced.

cases.prompt: Thirty concurrent requests redeem the same one-time coupon more than once.
cases.reason: One-time consumption and count enforcement are not atomic.

cases.prompt: The primary client forces traffic through a VPN, but a recovery URL handler sends the same request over the normal network during reconnect.
cases.reason: An alternate lifecycle path violates a mandatory network policy.

cases.prompt: A valid signature for a staging update object is accepted for a production update because the environment and object type are not signed.
cases.reason: Mathematical validity is not bound to the business context and replay state.

cases.prompt: An unauthenticated handshake returns a salt, challenge, and MAC that let a client decide password guesses without contacting the server again.
cases.reason: Stable pre-authentication material exposes an offline correctness function.

cases.prompt: A SAML response signature verifies one assertion while SSO business logic consumes a different assertion node.
cases.reason: The verified XML object differs from the consumed object.

cases.prompt: A negative protocol length passes a signed comparison and becomes a large unsigned allocation size in native code.
cases.reason: Checking and allocation use different value types and ranges.

cases.prompt: A privileged archive wrapper passes an attacker-controlled filename beginning with a command option to the final executable.
cases.reason: A surface filename becomes a privileged command-line option.

cases.prompt: A validated temporary path is replaced with a symlink before a privileged process opens it.
cases.reason: Validation and use reach different filesystem objects.

cases.prompt: Small but valid DNSSEC responses create a superlinear number of signature verification attempts and exhaust resolver CPU.
cases.reason: Valid structured input creates attacker-controlled worst-case computational cost.

cases.prompt: A restricted container exposes the host runtime socket and can ask the daemon to mount a host directory.
cases.reason: A proxied host capability bypasses the stated container isolation boundary.

cases.prompt: A low-privilege local user can call a root D-Bus method with an arbitrary destination path and cause a privileged file write.
cases.reason: A privileged IPC service does not constrain caller identity and delegated object capability.
